objective: baseline-relative Pareto closure.  A candidate is ACCEPTED only when it is strictly better than Stage6A R1 on the TH_IP_30 and TH_IP_45 min face-area ratio AND face-area p05, and not worse on max edge stretch, intra-thumb self-intersection, TH_MCP_45, and the 15/30 deg cases. selection_rule: (1) satisfy A-F plus every hard gate; (2) all four required improvements must be at least +25% (a CLEAR Pareto improvement -- a candidate that is merely 'least bad' is never promoted); (3) among those, minimise the worst residual regression over all six thumb cases and all five recorded metric families; (4) then maximise the required improvement

alternatives_reported_to_human_review.note: no candidate in the swept family keeps min_edge_ratio non-regressed on every restricted case; the promoted candidate is the highest worst-case non-regression margin among the candidates whose four required improvements are all at least +25%
